name: patchbay-go
description: Cloudflare Pages worker that wraps custom URL schemes (obsidian://, x-apple-reminderkit://, calshow:, ...) in https:// links so chat apps recognize them as tappable. Optional KV-backed key vault.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name patchbay-go --branch main
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
